answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 8404 Country: India Title: I am working in Saudi Arabia. I am doing Qurbani in India. 1, Is it right? 2, Here in KSA Eid uz Zuha falls 1 or 2 days earlier than in India. Shall I do my Qurbani as per Eid in KSA or as per India. Question: I am working in Saudi Arabia. I am doing Qurbani in India. 1, Is it right? 2, Here in KSA Eid uz Zuha falls 1 or 2 days earlier than in India. Shall I do my Qurbani as per Eid in KSA or as per India. Answer ID: 8404 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2097/1682=B/1429) First of all, you should offer your Qurbani in Saudi itself. If, due to any reason, you want to offer it in India then you can do it in a day which is Qurbani day in both the countries, otherwise the Qurbani will not be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
